claims: "i" is a 2014 song by Kendrick Lamar from his album To Pimp a Butterfly.
"i" by Kendrick Lamar was released on September 23, 2014.
"i" by Kendrick Lamar heavily samples the Isley Brothers.
"i" by Kendrick Lamar has live, high-energy production.
"i" by Kendrick Lamar won a Grammy for Best Rap Song at the 57th Grammy Awards.
"i" by Kendrick Lamar won a Grammy for Best Rap Performance at the 57th Grammy Awards.
"i" by Kendrick Lamar features a "live" feel in its production.
"i" by Kendrick Lamar includes a spoken-word performance in the middle of the track.
"i" by Kendrick Lamar has been featured in trailers for Top Five, Dope, How to Be Single, and The Intern.
